selected_source.name: English Wikipedia
selected_source.population: English-language, namespace-0 encyclopedia article revisions in one completed dated Wikimedia pages-articles multistream dump
selected_source.language_variety: Collaboratively edited international English; national variety is not controlled and no variety-specific inference is permitted
selected_source.period: The revision state in the completed 2026-09-01 English Wikipedia dump, whose exact recombined content/index filenames, bytes, MD5, SHA-1, and metadata retrieval time are frozen in resources/source_manifest.json

acquisition.required_artifact: enwiki-YYYYMMDD-pages-articles-multistream.xml.bz2 and its matching index and checksum files
rules: Use a completed dated directory, never the mutable /latest/ alias.
Pin the exact filename, bytes, upstream checksum, local SHA-256, retrieval time, page ID, revision ID, revision timestamp, and source-text hash.
Filter to namespace 0 and exclude redirects before sampling; IR-121 freezes every further content-neutral eligibility rule.
Do not acquire or redistribute images, audio, video, or other non-text media.

rights_basis.acquisition: Wikimedia publishes dated pages-articles dumps containing page metadata, revision metadata, and complete page content.
rights_basis.annotation_and_derivative: Modified or added material based on reused Wikimedia text must be released under CC BY-SA 4.0 or later and identified as modified.
rights_basis.redistribution: Text may be reused under the applicable license with author attribution, a license notice/link, ShareAlike, and preservation of any additional imported-text attribution.
rights_basis.persistence: The release must bundle the selected text and also record permanent revision/history URLs, exact revision IDs, and hashes so a third party can verify or reconstruct it.
rights_basis.page_level_review: Before admission, inspect the page footer, history, talk page, and visible attribution notices. Exclude any revision with unresolved imported-text, fair-use, or attribution obligations before target search.

candidate_audit.candidate: English Wikipedia dated namespace-0 article revisions

candidate_audit.reason: The inspected projection and labels are already exposed development evidence and cannot become a new independent sealed benchmark.
The frozen frame reached a maximum of eight eligible adult/unspecified units against a ten-unit stop, and United States availability did not establish Japanese or worldwide redistribution rights.

release_route_comparison.implementation: Release only the sampled article text, standoff offsets/labels, attribution manifest, change notice, and CC BY-SA 4.0 notice; keep project code under its existing license.
release_route_comparison.reason: A bundled immutable analysis copy gives third parties the strongest obtainability and byte identity.

release_route_comparison.implementation: Keep stable document, token, and occurrence IDs in the public bundle.
release_route_comparison.reason: Standoff data reduces duplication but does not itself resolve source rights or guarantee future source availability.

release_route_comparison.implementation: Publish revision/history URLs, revision IDs, normalization version, offsets, and hashes with a fail-closed checker.
release_route_comparison.reason: Reconstruction verifies provenance but a revision may later become unavailable or suppressed.

target_blind_order: freeze this source and release decision
pin the completed dated dump identity under IR-113
freeze content-neutral eligibility, strata, seed, and sampling under IR-121
draw documents and complete page-level rights review without target or MWE search
release_fail_closed_rules: Exclude a page before target search if its license or additional attribution cannot be resolved.
Do not silently substitute another revision or page after observing target yield.
Reject reconstruction when any source-text, normalization, token, or occurrence hash differs.
Do not make a public benchmark-availability claim until the release bundle and clean-room reconstruction check exist.

official_sources.supports: Text licensing, attribution routes, imported-text notices, reuse, ShareAlike, and change/license notices.
Dated dump naming and pages-articles page/revision metadata with complete content.
Revision IDs, timestamps, content hashes, multistream structure, and index format.
